refutedOnReview: REFUTED — the dialect should not exist at all, and its model list is partly invented.  1. Category error: an RTS has no register map. RTS300R47K3.81A is a passive NTC thermistor probe ("R47K" = 47 kΩ NTC) that plugs into the controller's RTS port. It has no Modbus interface, no slave ID, no baud rate, no registers. It is not a device and cannot become one. It has no protocol; it is read by the charge controller and surfaces on the controller's own Modbus map. Creating a DeviceKind::EnvironmentSensor entry for EPEver would invent a device that does not exist.

Which register carries it is genuinely disputed and is recorded under epever-tracer-a: B-Series v2.3, the LS-B V1.1 doc and kasbert all put the RTS reading at 0x311B ("The battery temperature measured by remote temperature sensor") while 0x3110 is plain "Battery Temperature"; the shipping driver maps 0x3110. It reads the BATTERY, not the room. Even mapped correctly it is battery-temperature, never temperature. A cabin that wants an air temperature reading needs the 1-Wire or GPIO path, not EPEver.
